```{r}
library(raster)
library(leaflet)
library(shiny)
library(tmap)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
r<-raster(here("output_data/Nutrients/Fiji_connected_N_plumes.tif"))
pal<-colorNumeric(c("#0C2C84", "#ff7400", "#ff0000"), values(r),
  na.color = "transparent")

leaflet() %>% addTiles() %>% 
  addRasterImage(r, colors = pal, opacity = 0.8) %>% 
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = values(r),
            title= "Connected Nitrogen pollution")
```

# Data for mapping
```{r}
fiji_basins12<-st_read(here("projected_data/Basins/Fiji_basins12.shp")) %>% 
  filter(!MAIN_BAS %in% c(5120082250)) %>% 
  mutate(ID = as.numeric(1)) %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(area_km2 = sum(area_km2, na.rm = T))


coral_export<-st_read(here("output_data/Nutrients/Fiji_corals_nutrient_export.shp")) 

coral_export<- coral_export %>% 
  st_transform(., st_crs(fiji_basins12)) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_crop(., fiji_basins12) %>% 
  mutate(N_tonnes=Total_N *0.001,
         P_tonnes= Total_P *0.001)

#coral_export_long<-coral_export %>% 
#  pivot_longer(., cols =c("Fj_c_N_" ,"Fj_c_P_" , "Fj_n_N_" , "Fj_n_P_" , "Fj___N_" , "Fj___P_" , "Total_N" , "Total_P" , "Ttl_ntr"), #names_to = "type", values_to = "value") %>% 
#  st_as_sf()

#conn_N<-raster(here("output_data/Nutrients/Fiji_connected_N_plumes.tif"))
```

```{r}
fiji<-tm_shape(fiji_basins12) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_fill("linen")

fiji
```

```{r}
test<-coral_export %>% 
  mutate(Ttl_ntr=ifelse(Ttl_ntr<=0, NA, as.numeric(Ttl_ntr)))

total_nutrients<-tm_shape(test) +
  tm_fill(col = "Ttl_ntr", 
          title = "Total nutrients (kg)", 
          style = "order",
          textNA = "Zero or NA") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = FALSE, bg.color = "lightblue",
            legend.position=c("left", "top"))

total_nutrients
```

```{r}
test<-coral_export %>% 
  mutate(Total_N=ifelse(Total_N<=0, NA, as.numeric(Total_N)))

total_N<-tm_shape(test) +
  tm_fill(col = "Total_N", 
          title = "Nitrogen (kg)", 
          style = "order",
           textNA = "Zero or NA") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = FALSE, bg.color = "lightblue",
            legend.position=c("left", "top"))
```


```{r}
test<-coral_export %>% 
  mutate(Total_P=ifelse(Total_P<=0, NA, as.numeric(Total_P)))

total_P<-tm_shape(test) +
  tm_fill(col = "Total_P", 
          title = "Phosphorus (kg)", 
          style = "order",
           textNA = "Zero or NA") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = FALSE, bg.color = "lightblue",
            legend.position=c("left", "top"))
```

```{r}
nutri1<-fiji + total_N +tm_scale_bar(position=c("right", "bottom"))
nutri2<-fiji + total_P
nutri3<-fiji + total_nutrients
```


```{r}
n_p_all<-tmap_arrange(nutri1, nutri2, nutri3, ncol = 3, nrow = 1)
n_p_all
```

```{r}
tmap_save(n_p_all, here("figures/Fiji_N_P_all.png"), width=20, height=8, asp=0)
```
